text:
dave: Quick RN draft for tomorrow's micro-release (runtime v2.4.1). Change window 02:00 PT -> 03:00 PT. Scope: batching stall fix, Dedicated autoscaler cooldown tuned, KV cache cold-start NPE guard. Need fast thumbs and rollback plan.

sam-ops: I'll run the deploy. Canary plan proposal: 4% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds. Health checks: error rate <2%, p95 <800ms, no new pagerduty. Rollback triggers: sustained error >=2% for 5m OR p95 >900ms for 8m. If rollback, pin to v2.4.0 for 45m.

nora: LGTM. RN note: add Known Impact line: "Dedicated customers may see brief reconnects during pool churn." I'll add to doc.

ethan: Infra prefers pin 60m given KV change, but 45m OK if eng-runtime agrees. Also add runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy and the oncall list.

sam-ops: Deploy command when staging smoke is green:
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.4.1 canary=4% step=10m health=svc-metrics-check
```
Abort: `deploybot cancel 1837770000`. Rollback manual cmd saved:
```
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.4.0 --reason "canary fail"
routing pin runtime v2.4.0 --duration 45m
```

deploybot: deploy queued by sam-ops. Staging smoke passed at 01:12 PT. Canary plan loaded. Will post step updates and metric snapshots.

dave: Communications: 01:40 PT staff brief, 01:50 internal blast, 02:00 deploy. Nora, can you cut the brief?

nora: Yep will cut at 01:40. RN updated with Known Impact and runbook.

ethan: Confirming infra standby and runbook paging (@oncall-runtime, @infra-ops). I'll set the routing pin ready.

sam-ops: All good. Starting at 02:00 PT unless someone yells hold. Deploybot will ping on each step. :rocket:

dave: Thanks team  final check: accept rollback thresholds and 45m pin?

nora: Accept.

ethan: Accept (will stand by for 60m pin if needed).

sam-ops: Accept. Kicking at 02:00 unless hold.
